e.title: Risk Radar 2026
e.summary: 2026 保险业风险雷达：AI/监管压力/气候暴露居保险公司风险议程之首
e.body: Risk Radar 2026（sparke.com.au，Asia Insurance Review 报道）：2026 年保险业风险调查——AI、监管压力、气候暴露居保险公司风险议程之首。对 RIAA：保险业风险格局的年度快照——「AI 成为头号风险」的行业信号（与 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 的全球市场、[[rga-hk-market-2026]] 的港险视角互补）；理解保险风险管理（[[rim520]]）的现实议程；AI 既是机会也是风险的行业共识；面试/研究的行业风险谈资。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：sparke 官网确认（Risk Radar 2026 风险调查），未通读
e.summary_en: 2026 insurer risk radar: AI, regulatory pressure and climate exposure top the insurer risk agenda
e.summary_hk: 2026 保險業風險雷達：AI/監管壓力/氣候暴露居保險公司風險議程之首
e.body_en: Risk Radar 2026 (sparke.com.au, reported by Asia Insurance Review): the 2026 insurer risk survey — AI, regulatory pressure and climate exposure top the insurer risk agenda. For RIAA: an annual snapshot of the insurance risk landscape — the industry signal that 'AI is a top risk' (complementing the global market of [[swiss-re-sigma]] and the HK view of [[rga-hk-market-2026]]); understand the real agenda of insurance risk management ([[rim520]]); the industry consensus that AI is both opportunity and risk; industry-risk talking points for interviews and research.
e.body_hk: Risk Radar 2026（sparke.com.au，Asia Insurance Review 報道）：2026 年保險業風險調查——AI、監管壓力、氣候暴露居保險公司風險議程之首。對 RIAA：保險業風險格局的年度快照——「AI 成為頭號風險」的行業信號（與 [[swiss-re-sigma]] 的全球市場、[[rga-hk-market-2026]] 的港險視角互補）；理解保險風險管理（[[rim520]]）的現實議程；AI 既是機會也是風險的行業共識；面試/研究的行業風險談資。
